description: Conformance cases for context.json of the AIContext specification 0.1.0 (draft). Each case is a complete context.json. A case is valid when an implementation reports no error for it; for an invalid case it MUST report at least one error located at 'pointer' (an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the document; the empty string is the document root). 'spec' names the section of SPEC.md that makes the case valid or invalid (5.1 properties, 5.2 rules beyond the schema). 'beyondSchema' marks a case that a JSON Schema evaluator with default settings accepts, so the implementation has to enforce the rule itself. Only the location is part of the contract, not the wording of the message.
